column1: (BMWM) system of SSKMCH is satisfactory. As the facility is yet to run in full scale therefore generation of
waste is still in low volume which is managed adequately. Since the hospital has no indoor facility therefore
no medical waste is generated from the hospital. It is currently operation only with the OPD and people are
consulting with the doctors only. The conservancy division of Gopalganj Municipality dispose of and
manage waste generated from the hospital.
